items.name: Rations Pack
items.desc: Adds three supplies per pack. A practical contribution to the argument that people need to eat.

items.name: Water Jugs
items.desc: Adds two supplies. Carried water jugs prevent the extra sanity and health costs of prolonged heat.

items.name: Spare Tire
items.desc: One spare tire. Can be fitted for a tire breakdown; fitting consumes the spare.

items.name: Battery
items.desc: One spare battery. Can be fitted when the battery fails; it is not an alternator.

items.name: Alternator
items.desc: One spare alternator. Restores the failed charging component when fitted during its matching breakdown.

items.name: Fuel Pump
items.desc: One spare fuel pump. Fits a fuel-pump breakdown; it does not add fuel or repair unrelated faults.

items.name: Masks
items.desc: Carried masks protect against smoke’s sanity cost and reduce illness risk. Other smoke costs still apply.

items.name: Warm Coats
items.desc: Warm coats protect against cold’s sanity cost and health damage from prolonged cold exposure.

items.name: Ponchos
items.desc: Ponchos protect against storm sanity loss. Other storm costs still apply.

items.name: Press Pass
items.desc: A unique permit item. At crossings that accept it, it can authorize passage without consuming a Receipt.

items.name: Legal Fund
items.desc: Adds one credibility. Does not automatically protect you from tariff costs.
